"""Text-to-SQL harness with execution-grounded verification and cheap deterministic repair.

Contract (fixed): solve(task, env) -> {"sql": str}
Budget strategy: at most one extra policy call, and only when the executed draft is
still empty/erroneous after free read-only probes. Most repairs cost zero tokens.
"""

import re

SQL_BLOCK = re.compile(r"```(?:sql|sqlite)?\s*(.*?)```", re.S | re.I)
LITERAL = re.compile(r"'([^']*)'")
IDENT = r"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z_0-9]*"
FROM_JOIN = re.compile(r"\b(?:FROM|JOIN)\s+(" + IDENT + r")", re.I)
ALIAS = re.compile(r"\b(?:FROM|JOIN)\s+(" + IDENT + r")(?:\s+(?:AS\s+)?(" + IDENT + r"))?", re.I)
RESERVED = {
    "where", "on", "join", "inner", "left", "right", "outer", "cross", "natural",
    "group", "order", "limit", "having", "union", "intersect", "except", "as",
    "select", "set", "using", "and", "or", "not", "in", "is", "like", "between",
}


def extract_sql(text):
    blocks = [b.strip() for b in SQL_BLOCK.findall(text or "") if b.strip()]
    if blocks:
        return blocks[-1].rstrip(";").strip()
    return (text or "").strip().rstrip(";").strip()


def _tables(sql):
    seen, out = set(), []
    for t in FROM_JOIN.findall(sql):
        if t.lower() not in seen:
            seen.add(t.lower())
            out.append(t)
    return out


def _schema_columns(schema):
    """table -> list of (column_name, declared_type), parsed from CREATE statements."""
    cols = {}
    for m in re.finditer(r"CREATE\s+TABLE\s+[\"'`\[]?(" + IDENT + r")[\"'`\]]?\s*\((.*?)\)\s*;",
                         schema or "", re.S | re.I):
        table, body = m.group(1), m.group(2)
        depth, cur, parts = 0, "", []
        for ch in body:
            if ch == "(":
                depth += 1
            elif ch == ")":
                depth -= 1
            if ch == "," and depth == 0:
                parts.append(cur)
                cur = ""
            else:
                cur += ch
        parts.append(cur)
        entries = []
        for p in parts:
            p = p.strip()
            if not p:
                continue
            first = p.split()[0].strip('"`[]\'')
            if first.upper() in ("PRIMARY", "FOREIGN", "UNIQUE", "CHECK", "CONSTRAINT"):
                continue
            typ = p[len(p.split()[0]):].strip().upper()
            entries.append((first, typ))
        cols[table] = entries
    return cols


def _text_columns(schema_cols, tables):
    out = []
    lower = {t.lower(): t for t in schema_cols}
    for t in tables:
        real = lower.get(t.lower())
        if not real:
            continue
        for name, typ in schema_cols[real]:
            if any(k in typ for k in ("CHAR", "TEXT", "CLOB")) or typ == "":
                out.append((real, name))
    return out


def _probe_literal(env, schema_cols, tables, value, limit=40):
    """Find actual stored values resembling `value` in text columns of used tables."""
    core = value.strip()
    if not core:
        return []
    found = []
    for table, col in _text_columns(schema_cols, tables)[:limit]:
        q = ("SELECT DISTINCT \"%s\" FROM \"%s\" WHERE \"%s\" LIKE '%%%s%%' LIMIT 3"
             % (col, table, col, core.replace("'", "''")))
        r = env.execute(q, max_rows=3)
        if r.get("ok") and r.get("rows"):
            for row in r["rows"]:
                v = row[0]
                if isinstance(v, str) and v not in found:
                    found.append(v)
        if len(found) >= 3:
            break
    return found


def _try_swap_join_keys(sql):
    """For a single equality ON a.x = b.y, try the reversed key pairing."""
    m = re.search(r"\bON\s+(" + IDENT + r")\.(\"?" + IDENT + r"\"?)\s*=\s*("
                  + IDENT + r")\.(\"?" + IDENT + r"\"?)", sql, re.I)
    if not m:
        return None
    a, ca, b, cb = m.groups()
    swapped = "%s.%s = %s.%s" % (a, cb, b, ca)
    if swapped.lower() == m.group(0)[3:].lower().strip():
        return None
    return sql[:m.start()] + "ON " + swapped + sql[m.end():]


def _fk_alternatives(sql, schema):
    """Yield candidate SQLs re-pointing joins using declared FOREIGN KEY clauses."""
    fks = []
    for m in re.finditer(r"CREATE\s+TABLE\s+[\"'`\[]?(" + IDENT + r")[\"'`\]]?\s*\((.*?)\)\s*;",
                         schema or "", re.S | re.I):
        table, body = m.group(1), m.group(2)
        for f in re.finditer(r"FOREIGN\s+KEY\s*\(\s*[\"'`\[]?(" + IDENT + r")[\"'`\]]?\s*\)\s*"
                             r"REFERENCES\s+[\"'`\[]?(" + IDENT + r")[\"'`\]]?\s*"
                             r"\(\s*[\"'`\[]?(" + IDENT + r")[\"'`\]]?\s*\)", body, re.I):
            fks.append((table, f.group(1), f.group(2), f.group(3)))
    aliases = {}
    for t, a in ALIAS.findall(sql):
        if a and a.lower() not in RESERVED:
            aliases[a.lower()] = t.lower()
        aliases.setdefault(t.lower(), t.lower())
    on_matches = list(re.finditer(r"\bON\s+(" + IDENT + r")\.(\"?" + IDENT + r"\"?)\s*=\s*("
                                 + IDENT + r")\.(\"?" + IDENT + r"\"?)", sql, re.I))
    cands = []
    for m in on_matches:
        a, ca, b, cb = m.groups()
        ta, tb = aliases.get(a.lower()), aliases.get(b.lower())
        ca, cb = ca.strip('"'), cb.strip('"')
        for (ft, fc, rt, rc) in fks:
            if ft.lower() == ta and rt.lower() == tb and fc.lower() != ca.lower():
                new = "%s.%s = %s.%s" % (a, fc, b, rc)
                cands.append(sql[:m.start()] + "ON " + new + sql[m.end():])
            if ft.lower() == tb and rt.lower() == ta and fc.lower() != cb.lower():
                new = "%s.%s = %s.%s" % (a, rc, b, fc)
                cands.append(sql[:m.start()] + "ON " + new + sql[m.end():])
    return cands


def solve(task, env):
    schema = env.schema(task["db_id"])
    user = f"Database: {task['db_id']}\n\nSchema:\n{schema}\n\nQuestion: {task['question']}"
    desc = ""
    try:
        desc = env.descriptions(task["db_id"]) or ""
    except Exception:
        pass
    if desc:
        user += f"\nColumn descriptions:\n{desc[:3000]}"
    if task.get("hint"):
        user += f"\nHint: {task['hint']}"
    messages = [{"role": "system", "content": env.prompt("system_prompt.md")},
                {"role": "user", "content": user}]
    reply = env.chat(messages, max_tokens=env.config.get("max_tokens", 800))
    sql = extract_sql(reply)

    result = env.execute(sql)
    if result.get("ok") and result.get("n_rows", 0) > 0:
        return {"sql": sql}

    schema_cols = _schema_columns(schema)
    tables = _tables(sql)

    # --- Free repair 1: quoted literals that match nothing -> probe stored values.
    if result.get("ok"):
        fixed_sql = sql
        changed = False
        for lit in dict.fromkeys(LITERAL.findall(sql)):
            if not lit.strip() or "%" in lit or "_" in lit:
                continue
            probe = env.execute(
                "SELECT 1 WHERE EXISTS (%s)" %
                re.sub(r"^SELECT\b", "SELECT", fixed_sql, flags=re.I)
                .replace("'%s'" % lit, "'%s'" % lit) + " LIMIT 1"
            ) if False else None
            # cheap existence check per literal across used tables
            exists = False
            for table, col in _text_columns(schema_cols, tables)[:40]:
                r = env.execute("SELECT 1 FROM \"%s\" WHERE \"%s\" = '%s' LIMIT 1"
                                % (table, col, lit.replace("'", "''")), max_rows=1)
                if r.get("ok") and r.get("rows"):
                    exists = True
                    break
            if exists:
                continue
            alts = _probe_literal(env, schema_cols, tables, lit)
            exact = [v for v in alts if v.strip().lower() == lit.strip().lower()]
            if len(exact) == 1 or (len(alts) == 1):
                new_val = (exact or alts)[0]
                fixed_sql = fixed_sql.replace("'%s'" % lit, "'%s'" % new_val.replace("'", "''"))
                changed = True
        if changed:
            r2 = env.execute(fixed_sql)
            if r2.get("ok") and r2.get("n_rows", 0) > 0:
                return {"sql": fixed_sql}
            if r2.get("ok"):
                sql = fixed_sql  # keep improved literals for later steps

    # --- Free repair 2: empty result -> try corrected join keys (swap / declared FKs).
    if result.get("ok"):
        candidates = []
        sw = _try_swap_join_keys(sql)
        if sw:
            candidates.append(sw)
        candidates.extend(_fk_alternatives(sql, schema))
        tried = {sql.lower()}
        for cand in candidates:
            if cand.lower() in tried:
                continue
            tried.add(cand.lower())
            r3 = env.execute(cand)
            if r3.get("ok") and r3.get("n_rows", 0) > 0:
                return {"sql": cand}

    # --- Paid repair: only now spend the second policy call, with concrete evidence.
    feedback = []
    if not result.get("ok"):
        feedback.append("The query failed with error: %s" % result.get("error"))
    else:
        feedback.append("The query executed but returned 0 rows, which is suspicious.")
        for lit in dict.fromkeys(LITERAL.findall(sql)):
            if not lit.strip() or "%" in lit:
                continue
            alts = _probe_literal(env, schema_cols, tables, lit)
            if alts:
                feedback.append("Literal '%s' may not exist as written; similar stored values: %s"
                                % (lit, ", ".join(repr(v) for v in alts[:3])))
    feedback.append("Re-check join keys against the schema's FOREIGN KEY clauses, literal spelling "
                    "(including trailing spaces), and whether the question wants all columns of the "
                    "main entity (SELECT T1.*) rather than a narrow projection.")
    messages.append({"role": "assistant", "content": reply})
    messages.append({"role": "user", "content": "\n".join(feedback) +
                     "\nReturn a corrected query in a single ```sql block."})
    try:
        reply2 = env.chat(messages, max_tokens=env.config.get("max_tokens", 800))
        sql2 = extract_sql(reply2)
        if sql2:
            r4 = env.execute(sql2)
            if r4.get("ok"):
                return {"sql": sql2}
            if not result.get("ok"):
                return {"sql": sql2}
    except Exception:
        pass
    return {"sql": sql}
